title: 1. Mouthwatering
slide_intent: Link descriptive language with sensory imagery so viewers can imagine the product’s taste and texture.
strategic_value: A close view of hands holding a burger can make Burger King’s food the focal point of the identity.
demonstration: Brown principle copy occupies the left side of a yellow field; hands and an oversized burger fill the right and lower edge.
practical_value: Compare whether an image makes ingredients and eating cues immediately visible.

content_islands.name: Principle copy
content_islands.spec: Place the numbered heading and two short paragraphs at left.

content_islands.name: Food and hands
content_islands.spec: Let the burger and hands dominate the right, cropped at the page edges.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy connects food pride and brand elements with taste and flavor.
reference_purposes.Expression: The large food photograph shows bun, vegetables, cheese and hands in a saturated warm setting.

ingredient.name: Food close-up
ingredient.role: Make taste and texture easy to imagine.
ingredient.application: Use the example to evaluate ingredient visibility and the immediacy of an eating gesture.
ingredient.scope: Observed principle illustration in the 2020 partner guide; no numeric crop ratio is prescribed.
